units.source_text: 或是逃课或是停课的学生三五成群地在远处练习投球，另五六个学生则在近处练习马拉松。

en.t: students who had either skipped class or had their classes canceled were practicing throwing balls in small groups in the distance, while another five or six students were practicing marathon running nearby.

units.source_text: 战争结束刚两年，青年们又在企图消耗自己的精力。

en.t: Only two years had passed since the war ended, and the young men were once again trying to burn off their energy.

units.source_text: 我回想着寺庙的粗茶淡饭。

en.t: I thought back to the plain fare at the temple.
